nodes.label: Stage 6 — caption
nodes.rationale: Was two halves: deterministic alignment plus a captioning half with no vision client at all (llm.py was text-only). The transport was never the missing part, only the message shape and configuration. Failure behaviour changed deliberately: NO_ENDPOINT continues the run with non-zero exit per the stage 7 contract — a note without slide content is a worse note, not no note, but the run must say it out loud.

nodes.label: Stage 7 — synth
nodes.rationale: TemplateSynthesizer exists so the pipeline runs end to end with no model configured; stage 6 must not be the stage that breaks that contract.

nodes.label: Stage 12 — report
nodes.rationale: Since 5c66731 the coverage claim is computable on the artefact: verified ∪ unchecked = files_in_bundle_excluding_this_stage. Before that release the prose claimed 143 files were checked when 65 were — the artefact is the correction. files_checked == files_in_bundle_excluding_this_stage is the end state (#87, presence-only per-file check is the deeper constraint).

nodes.label: resolve_estimator registry
nodes.rationale: The 'vlm' name was removed from the registry (#67): a vision bbox source is a real idea still unbuilt, and an unbuilt option should be absent rather than present and broken.

nodes.label: IMPLEMENTED = 12 constant
nodes.rationale: A declaration, not a measurement. It was false while stage 6 had no vision client and became true as of #67; if a stage is ever opened again the constant keeps claiming it is closed and no test catches that. Its citation previously pointed at the wrong decision (docs D3 instead of ADR-0001 § The pipeline).

nodes.label: export_to_vault
nodes.rationale: Ends in mkdir(parents=True), so exporting to a typo would materialise an empty directory that dyak doctor then certifies as healthy; a nonexistent vault path is reported and named, never created.

nodes.label: caption_status per frame
nodes.rationale: NO_NEW_INFORMATION says the model declined; it is a success, not an error, and a high share means the screens went unread.

nodes.label: Suites are not hermetic (#63)
nodes.rationale: test_stages.py and test_doctor.py read ambient DYAK_* and fail when exported; pre-existing, filed as #63. DYAK_SETTINGS pinned in this work because running the suite created real-vault settings and wrote transcript files into the developer's obs_notes directory.

nodes.label: D<n> decision numbering convention
nodes.rationale: D<n> means decision n within this ADR; the number is file-local, so an unqualified D4 in this repo is ambiguous (ADR-0001 D4 frame gating vs ADR-0004 D4 provenance). Write the full ADR-000N Dn form whenever a reference leaves its file.

nodes.label: Cross-ADR dependencies register
nodes.rationale: Explicit couplings: ADR-0004 implements ADR-0001 D5 and D8 (its D3 vision sections are the unbuilt vision endpoint design, #67); ADR-0002 D3 depends on superseded ADR-0001 D2; ADR-0005's ~17-states assumption was corrected to 58 frames; ADR-0005 D2's gate acceptance was satisfied vacuously for eight runs (#82); ADR-0003 D4 assumes blocking work stays blocking and needs re-measurement.

nodes.label: Stage status authority map
nodes.rationale: The stage→module→open/closed map lives in docs/stages.md, which is the authority on what is actually built; the ADRs record what was decided, which is not the same thing.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 D1 — pipeline emits events
nodes.rationale: Human-readable output is the default rendering of the same event stream, not a second code path; stages 7 and 9 are single blocking requests with no intermediate steps to display, so per-step progress would trade output determinism for cosmetics.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 D2 — only observable facts are events
nodes.rationale: Model-reported progress percentages are the model's estimate of itself — a bar driven by them is precisely the ADR-0001 D7 lie.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003 d2 — only observable facts are events

nodes.label: ADR-0003 D3 — versioned event stream
nodes.rationale: "v":1 on every line; the stream is a public interface the moment it ships, and versioning discipline is the price of admission.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 D4 — blocking work is bracketed
nodes.rationale: The gap between the estimate interval and the actual elapsed time is data, emitted rather than hidden; stage 3 already prints the bracket and D1 generalises it to every blocking stage.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003 d4 — blocking work is bracketed

nodes.label: ADR-0004 D1 — one config file, env overrides
nodes.rationale: Precedence: environment > file > built-in default. Keys come from the environment only so the file is safe to keep in a dotfiles repo (ADR-0001 D9).
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004 d1 — one config file, env overrides

nodes.label: ADR-0004 D2 — dyak config set|get|list
nodes.rationale: Validates on write; the CLI is a convenience, not the only path. A TUI was rejected: a second binary to save two command-line arguments.

nodes.label: ADR-0004 D3 — separate vision and text sections
nodes.rationale: [vision]/[text] sections may point at the same endpoint; separating them means switching either later costs one line. Per the ADR README, this is the design for the vision endpoint ADR-0001 D8 promised and nobody built — see issue #67.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004 d3 — separate vision and text sections

nodes.label: ADR-0004 D4 — provenance in the artefact
nodes.rationale: A regression gate that cannot attribute a difference is not a gate: without model id, endpoint host and prompt version in every model-produced artefact, #3 cannot distinguish model change from prompt change from transcript change. Pairs with stage 6's cache key (frame hash + model id, #10).
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004 d4 — provenance in the artefact

nodes.label: ADR-0004 D5 — doctor reports endpoints, never the key
nodes.rationale: A truncated key is still a credential prefix and a hashed one tempts a reader to wonder whether it is reversible.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004 d5 — doctor reports endpoints, never the key

nodes.label: ADR-0006 D1 — caption call returns frame_class
nodes.rationale: No second model call, no new dependency, ADR-0002's single-dependency constraint untouched. Frames classed not_material are marked in the manifest and run report, not removed (ADR-0005 D2): a paged-notes frame wrongly removed is a missing piece of the note, a redundant frame only costs tokens.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006 d1 — caption call returns frame_class

nodes.label: frame_class label set
nodes.rationale: lecture_material | not_material | uncertain. The label set is a guess — it needs a hand-labelled sample of one lecture's frames before D1's prompt wording is trusted.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 D2 — local zero-shot classifier (deferred)
nodes.rationale: Deferred because the blocker is elsewhere (#84: captions never reach stage 7) and the cost argument is weak (7.7 min per lecture, 396k input tokens, #81). No dollar figure is given because the repository records no price — an earlier revision carried '~$0.0006 per frame' which was never measured, was flagged unsourced in #86's review, and is tracked as #96.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 D3 — triggers for building D2
nodes.rationale: Privacy (frames of a desktop or browser must not leave the machine — the audio already stays local) is the strongest trigger, then volume growth on other lectures, then measured VLM labelling error above an agreed rate.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006 d3 — triggers for building d2
